IV-COL-01.title: With every column on they appear in the fixed order with the set alignment
IV-COL-01.refs: SV-8670; SV-8674 (IV spec v3 2026-07-29 Story 3 S3-R1; S3-R2 + Story 7 S7-R6 — fixed column order and alignment; plus the automatic Location column between Vendor and Qty on Hand)
quotes: Every column (including Margin and Total Sell) is turned on in the column-selection control
Location is one of the columns in the column-selection control; when it is turned on the Location column appears between Vendor and Qty, left-aligned

IV-COL-04.title: On a first visit the default columns show and the rest stay available
IV-COL-04.refs: SV-8670; SV-8674 (IV spec v3 2026-07-29 Story 3 S3-R12; S3-R13; Story 8 S8-R3 + Story 7 S7-R6 — first-visit default columns; plus the automatic Location column when more than one location is in scope)
quotes: Open the column-selection control and read which columns are on and off
Both can be turned on from the column-selection control and then appear in their fixed positions
Location is one of the columns in the column-selection control; when it is turned on the Location column shows between Vendor and Qty

IV-PERS-02.title: Toggling columns never reorders them
IV-PERS-02.refs: SV-8675; SV-8674 (IV spec v3 2026-07-29 Story 8 S8-R4; Story 3 S3-R1 + Story 7 S7-R6 — toggling never reorders; plus the automatic Location column between Vendor and Qty on Hand)
quotes: Whatever columns are shown, they appear in the fixed left-to-right order - with Location, when it is turned on in the column-selection control, between Vendor and Qty (Part #, Description, Category, Vendor, Qty, Unit Cost, Unit Sell, Margin, Margin %, Total Sell, Total Cost) - toggling visibility never reorders columns

IV-EXP-02.title: Downloads keep shown columns and order, honor filters, and include Totals
IV-EXP-02.refs: SV-8677 (IV spec v3 2026-07-29 Story 10 S10-R3; S10-R4; S10-R5; S10-R6; S10-R15 — downloads keep the shown columns and order; honour the filters; include the Totals row; S10-R15 = the "Locations:" line and the automatic Location column)
quotes: Note for the tester: the files carry the Location column when Location is turned ON in the column-selection control (it sits between Vendor and Qty)

IV-LOC-06.title: The Location column sits after Vendor and never reads Multiple
IV-LOC-06.refs: SV-8674; SV-8677 (IV spec v3 2026-07-29 S7-R6; S7-R7; S3-R1; S12-R10; S10-R15 — Location column inserted between Vendor and Qty on Hand; automatic visibility; never "Multiple"; S10-R15 = the same column in every export)
quotes: Turn Location on in the column-selection control, select two or more locations, and read the column headers from the left
Open the column-selection control and look for Location in the list
With Location turned on in the column-selection control, a Location column is shown, inserted between Vendor and Qty

WIP-COL-01.title: With all toggleable columns on, the fixed column order and alignment hold
WIP-COL-01.refs: SV-8660 (WIP spec v6 2026-07-29 Story 4 S4-R1; S4-R3; S4-R4 — the Location column is no longer in the column selector; it shows automatically when more than one location is in scope)
quotes: Every toggleable column is turned on in the column-selection control
Location is turned ON in the column-selection control (it is off by default)

WIP-COL-02.title: First visit shows the default columns; the rest are in the column selector
WIP-COL-02.refs: SV-8660; SV-8664 (WIP spec v6 2026-07-29 Story 4 S4-R2; S4-R3 + Story 8 S8-R3; S8-R4 — S4-R3 verbatim: "The Location column is not offered in the column selector; its visibility is automatic")
quotes: First visit shows the default columns; the rest are in the column selector
Open the column-selection control and read which columns are offered and which are on
Hrs) is available in the column-selection control and off by default

WIP-FLT-09.title: The Location column is automatic and never reads Multiple on a work-order row
WIP-FLT-09.refs: SV-8663 (WIP spec v6 2026-07-29 S7-R13; S7-R14; S4-R3; S9-E1; S10-R5a; §4 Location (column) — automatic visibility; never "Multiple"; export header "Branch")
quotes: Open the column-selection control and look for Location in the list
Location is offered in the column-selection control, between VIN and Advisor, and is off by default
The column does not appear or disappear on its own when you change the location selection - it follows the column-selection toggle only
